capabilities: open all links in the selected text at once
choose the opening method (tab, window, or split pane)
assign a hotkey to trigger bulk opening
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open many selected links at once, so users must manually open each link individually.
summary: Bulk-opener that opens every link in a text selection at once in edit mode, via a configurable Tab, Window, or Split opening method.
